chief_complaint: severe back pain, fatigue, and frequent infections
hpi_details: 68F presents with 3 months of worsening lower back pain, profound fatigue, and two episodes of pneumonia requiring antibiotics. Labs show a new normocytic anemia, elevated creatinine, and hypercalcemia.

core_concepts: CRAB criteria: Calcium elevation, Renal insufficiency, Anemia, Bone lesions.
common_misconceptions: Attributing back pain in elderly solely to osteoarthritis when there are systemic red flags.
dangerous_errors: Missing impending spinal cord compression from a vertebral body lesion.
management_principles: SPEP/UPEP, skeletal survey, bone marrow biopsy, oncology referral.
boundaries_and_exceptions: Specific drug dosages, monitoring protocols, and referral criteria must be tailored to organ function, comorbidities, and local hospital pathways.
Atypical presentations in elderly, pediatric, or immunocompromised patients may require lower thresholds for inpatient monitoring and specialist consultation.

source_refs.title: UpToDate & National Evidence-Based Clinical Practice Guidelines 2026

reference_soap.subjective: 68F with chronic severe back pain, recurrent infections, and fatigue.
reference_soap.objective: Pale conjunctiva, midline lumbar spine tenderness. Labs show Ca 11.2, Cr 1.8, Hgb 9.5.
reference_soap.plan: SPEP with immunofixation, skeletal survey, nephrology and hematology consults.

learning_objectives: Identify the CRAB criteria for multiple myeloma.

teaching.one_liner: An elderly patient with bone pain, anemia, renal dysfunction, and hypercalcemia (CRAB criteria).
red_flags: New bone pain in elderly with anemia/hypercalcemia

must_ask.say: Where exactly is the back pain, and has it been getting worse over the past months?
Have you been getting infections more often than usual recently?
Have you noticed less urine output, or symptoms of feeling thirsty or confused?
Have you had any weakness in your legs, numbness, or trouble controlling your bladder or bowels?
How is the fatigue affecting your usual daily activities?
